response.sql: WITH f AS (SELECT rating, CAST(rental_rate AS DOUBLE) / rental_duration AS per_day FROM film WHERE rental_duration > 5), g AS (SELECT rating, AVG(per_day) AS avg_per_day, COUNT(*) AS films FROM f GROUP BY rating), b AS (SELECT AVG(avg_per_day) AS benchmark FROM g) SELECT g.rating, g.avg_per_day, g.films, g.avg_per_day / b.benchmark AS ratio_to_benchmark FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE b.benchmark IS NOT NULL;
